subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: License Plate Readers
description: A fast breakdown of License Plate Readers for builders.

hook.text: Cameras on police cars scan every license plate they pass — hundreds per minute, millions per year.

buildup.text: Automatic license plate readers capture plate numbers, timestamps, and GPS locations into databases.

discovery.text: The data builds a detailed map of where every car travels — even when no crime is suspected.

twist.text: Some departments store this data for years. Anyone with access can trace your driving history.

climax.text: A license plate reader doesn't just catch criminals. It records every car, every trip, every day.

punchline.text: Every plate scanned. Every trip logged. Always.

quiz.question: What privacy concern do automatic license plate readers raise?
options: They record the movements of all vehicles, not just suspects
They interfere with car GPS systems
